subject: Limited technical digest + auditor-only access request for pen-test evidence
body:
From: Alice Truong <alice.truong@acme-cloud.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acme-cloud.com
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request — limited technical digest + auditor access for pen-test evidence

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. As part of our upcoming security due diligence (SIG + SOC2 gap analysis) our external auditors have requested access to a concise technical digest of Redwood's most recent penetration test and the ability to view supporting evidence under a controlled, time-limited arrangement. They specifically asked for:

- Executive summary (redacted for customer-identifying details)
- A short technical digest (2-3 pages) that summarizes findings categorized by severity and affected components
- Controlled access for two named auditors (audit@thirdparty-audit.com, ben.howard@acme-cloud.com) to view attachments in a secure viewer for up to 7 days

We understand you may require an NDA addendum / limited redaction matrix. Please advise on what you can share and the recommended workflow. If you have a proposed redaction matrix or a viewer option (watermarking, IP-limited access, audit-only accounts), that would help us move quickly.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Truong
Head of Security Operations
Acme Cloud

---

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: Alice Truong <alice.truong@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — limited technical digest + auditor access for pen-test evidence

Hi Alice,

Appreciate the clear ask. We can provide a redacted executive summary and a 2-page technical digest. Options we propose:

1) Deliver redacted exec summary PDF + redaction matrix (Excel) via a secure, one-time URL (time-limited, IP-agnostic) with watermarking and click-to-download disabled.
2) Provide auditor-only access to our secured viewer for 7 days — viewers are watermarked with email, cannot download, and session activity is logged.
3) If your auditors need copies for evidence packages, we require a short NDA addendum that:
   - permits delivery of more detailed findings under strict redaction rules,
   - limits onward sharing to named auditors, and
   - mandates secure disposal after review.

Can you confirm the exact auditor emails and whether they need PDF copies or only view access? I will loop Legal (Rishi) to draft the addendum and propose the redaction matrix.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, Alice Truong <alice.truong@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — limited technical digest + auditor access for pen-test evidence

Priyom / Alice — adding some delivery detail from an ops perspective.

Proposal (low-friction):
- Attachments: redacted exec summary PDF + redaction_matrix_ACME.xlsx (shows what we redact and why).
- Secure viewer link: expires 7 days after issuance; viewers require SSO or one-time token (we can provision tokens to specific emails).
- Activity logging: capture IP, timestamp, and page view; logs delivered to Acme upon request after the window closes.
- Watermarking: email + "Confidential — For Audit Use Only" on each page.
- If Acme needs downloadable copies, we require the NDA addendum and DocuSign signature before release.

I'll attach the draft redaction matrix and a sample exec summary (we'll redact customer references and internal hostnames).

Attachments (stubs):
- RI_PenTest_ExecSummary_v0.3_redacted.pdf (stub, redacted)
- redaction_matrix_ACME.xlsx (stub)

Lauren Bishop
Manager, Customer Security Ops
Redwood Inference

---

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Truong <alice.truong@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — limited technical digest + auditor access for pen-test evidence

Team / Alice,

For legal: we can do an NDA addendum limited to:
- Purpose-limited access (audit-only) for named auditors
- Prohibition on copying/redistibution; requirement to destroy downloaded materials within 30 days (if we allow downloads at all)
- Redaction covenant: Redwood will deliver a redaction matrix; Acme's legal may request a limited rebuttal window but cannot demand raw evidence that identifies other customers or PII not relevant to Acme's environment.
- Escrow: If Acme requires source-level artifacts or raw logs, we will consider an escrow process but that requires a separate SOW and segregation of data.

I'll prepare a short addendum template and share a DocuSign link. For speed, if Acme confirms auditors and accepts viewer-only access, we can skip the addendum and proceed with secure viewer delivery.

Rishi Malhotra
General Counsel (on security matters)
Redwood Inference

---

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: Alice Truong <alice.truong@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 06:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — limited technical digest + auditor access for pen-test evidence

Alice — Per above, here's the proposed plan so we can close this quickly:

1) Immediate: Share redacted exec summary + redaction matrix via secure viewer link. Viewer will be active for 7 days (no download).
2) If Acme needs downloadable copies for audit packages: Rishi will issue an NDA addendum via DocuSign that names the two auditors and the exact permitted materials. Once signed, we'll provide password-protected PDFs for download.
3) Logging and provenance: We will provide an audit log export (CSV) after the viewing window showing session start/end, IPs, and pages viewed.

Please confirm auditor emails and whether viewer-only access suffices. Once confirmed we will issue the secure link.

Thanks,
Priyom

---

From: Ben Howard <ben.howard@acme-cloud.com>
To: Alice Truong <alice.truong@acme-cloud.com>, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acme-cloud.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — limited technical digest + auditor access for pen-test evidence

Priyom / Team —

Viewer-only access works for our auditors. Confirming two auditor emails: audit@thirdparty-audit.com and ben.howard@acme-cloud.com. They will only need to view during a single 5-day window; no downloads required.

We agree to the redaction approach you described. If you can send the viewer link and the redaction_matrix_ACME.xlsx now, we will review and confirm. If Rishi needs the signed addendum for any reason later, we can coordinate via DocuSign (please include a copy of the template).

Thanks,
Ben Howard
Security Compliance Lead
Acme Cloud

[Attachment references: RI_PenTest_ExecSummary_v0.3_redacted.pdf (viewer-only), redaction_matrix_ACME.xlsx (matrix)]
